# Recursica Prototype (Angular)

> A prototyping system for quick, throwaway UI prototypes built on the Recursica design system, using Angular and Angular Material.

## Docs

- [AGENT.md](./AGENT.md): Rules and process for AI agents building prototypes in this repo.
- [ARCHITECTURE.md](./ARCHITECTURE.md): Stack, tooling, and app structure.
- [docs/PROTOTYPE.md](./docs/PROTOTYPE.md): The designer-conversation process for creating a new prototype.
